{{Quote|Krand! Run a full diagnostic. Find out what was in these files.|Agent Galen|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Krand''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A tan-skinned<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> with [[black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], they were stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as an analyst under Agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]]. When the design files for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] were stolen by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] thief [[Vistis Garn]] for the criminal organization known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recovered the files]] and returned them to the Senate Tower. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] gave the files to Galen, who passed them off to his subordinate Krand and ordered them to decrypt the files and analyze their contents.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krand appeared in the Jedi Knight class mission "Stolen Secrets" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
